name: TV6 below one to one after returns, email left blank

hand_check: Parsing only. '€250,000.00' -> strip €, both separators present, last one is '.', so ',' is deleted -> 250000.00. '50 000' -> whitespace stripped -> 50000. '120.000' -> lone '.' followed by exactly 3 terminal digits -> thousands separator -> 120000. '45,000' -> lone ',' followed by 3 terminal digits -> thousands separator -> 45000. '' -> blank, so the remainder derives. Every downstream number is then identical to TV1 with the platform block hidden. Asserting equality with TV1 is the point of the vector.
